notes.title: Check out our new free update and ICE Level!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi folks,[/h1] 

We just launched our latest free update including a new endless level!

[h2]Endless Ice Level:[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841722/b03115d5c220b006231c017527a7c6e70babaa8c.png[/img]

The level includes the regular waves of enemies, but also adds bulky special enemies generating persistent ice stains that build up over time, gradually turning the map into an icy deathtrap. Kill them before they generate too much of it! 

Luckily, there are rewards in the form of in-game cosmetic items waiting for those that manage to survive long enough. It’s a pretty tricky one!

[h2]Change Log:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Ice level added
[*] New rewards added
[*] Minor performance and visual updates
[/list]

[h2]Music DLC:[/h2]
The Archons Original soundtrack by Oliver Orand is now also available to buy separately on Steam. Find it here: 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3672200/Archons__Soundtrack/

[url=https://discord.com/invite/53Pcj9YYvY]Join our Discord[/url] if you want to discuss and flex your ice level results!

notes.title: Steam Deck Verified and the latest Change Log!
notes.content:
[h1]Hi Archons! [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841722/3bf73f117eb2f29bacc33d969d599f10f9c09ee4.png[/img]

Coming in with a short update for you on Steam Deck. Archons have been working well on the Steam Deck since release, but there has been a few details in the way of being fully Verified and getting that green checkmark. We addressed these in a small update, and you can see the changes below.

[h2]Change Log:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Reworked input mapping to handle an issue with an external gamepad connection on Steam Deck
[*] Increased some text sizes that was considered to small on Steam Deck
[/list]
[h2]Join the Discord[/h2]
As always we’ll encourage you to join the [url=https://steamcommunity.com/linkfilter/?u=https%3A%2F%2Fdiscord.com%2Finvite%2F53Pcj9YYvY]Discord[/url] and hang out with us and our lovely community. Jump in and flex your Endless results, who knows, there might even be some nice competitions coming up…

We’ll be back later this spring with more concrete details on what's to come for Archons!

notes.title: What's next?
notes.content:
[h1]Welcome back Archons![/h1]

It's great to see how you, the players, are enjoying the game, leaving feedback and suggesting improvements. This is helpful in creating the best version possible, of Archons. We have some updates we'd like to share.


[h3]The Road Ahead[/h3]
During the last months we have been gathering feedback and suggestions from players on Steam and [url=https://discord.com/invite/53Pcj9YYvY]Discord[/url]. There are a lot of ideas brewing, and we are looking forward to share more of those with you soon. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44841722/5309e1e961161b948efcb6d46c65fb3e5d4253e9.png[/img]
[h3]The Steam Spring Sale[/h3]
Today, we are joining the much anticipated Steam Spring Sale. If you haven't already, go grab a copy at a discounted price or let your friends know - 25% for the coming week!

[h3]The Soundtrack[/h3]
Once again, [url=https://www.olivierorand.com/]Olivier Orand[/url] has really done a fantastic job on the Archons Official Soundtrack! Check it out [url=https://tunelink.to/archons_ost]here[/url] - available at Spotify, Bandcamp, Apple Music, Deezer and iTunes. But, we've heard your feedback! We are currently looking into releasing it on Steam as well - stay tuned (pun intended).

[h3]Join the Discord[/h3]
At the [url=https://discord.com/invite/53Pcj9YYvY]Discord[/url] you can share feedback, ask for tips & trix and chat with other Archons. Soon you will also be able to access an experimental branch for upcoming updates...

notes.title: Local Co-op included in full release
notes.content:
[img][/img]We've heard your feedback, and we agreed—adding a co-op mode to Archons was a must. We're excited to share a new version that lets you and a friend team up and play together. In this co-op mode, each player controls one character, bringing fresh strategies and interactions while keeping the core dual-control gameplay.

To maintain Archons' unique feel, we’ve made a few changes to abilities in co-op mode. Here are two examples:

[list]
[*] Co-op Hammer: Players can rotate their hammer with the right thumbstick for more precise control.
[*] Co-op Sawblade: The sawblade now gets an extra boost in the direction it’s pointed, allowing for more impactful team attacks.
[/list]

These changes ensure that while playing with a friend, the main idea of using both hands for control stays intact. We’re looking forward to seeing how you and your partner take on the game in this new mode.

Team up, practice your skills, and enjoy the new co-op experience in Archons!
